what: UBS is the world's largest wealth manager for rich clients and Switzerland's biggest bank. It took over Credit Suisse in 2023.
customers: Wealthy individuals and families worldwide, Swiss households and companies, and institutions.
money: advice and lending for wealthy clients
moat: A leading brand in private banking and unmatched scale in client assets.
opportunities: Revenue grew about 13% a year over three years including the Credit Suisse integration
Analysts see about 21% upside from current levels
Credit Suisse integration cost savings are still being delivered
watch: Integration cost savings and net new money in wealth management.
